status: Post hoc methodological reanalysis. Not a new preregistered confirmatory experiment.
instances: C001-C048; include all without outcome-based exclusions
split_rule: Sort replicate IDs 0..39 by SHA256(v19-e1-independent-2026-10-22|instance_id|replicate_id). First 10 fit, next 10 select, final 20 test. No rerandomization.
coefficients: Richardson order 1 at scales 1,2,3. Accuracy-ZNE minimum norm. Decision-ZNE fitted only on fit replicas, using covariance of primitive gaps and known ideal gaps as tuning references, not certified effective margins.
oracle_scope: Ideal landscape and optimum are available to tuning and MSE selection. This is an oracle-assisted simulation audit, not an operational unknown-ground-truth algorithm.
selection: Fit coefficients on fit only. Estimate MSE and Gaussian gap risk on select only. Use Ledoit-Wolf covariance for GRI, including when repetitions < gap dimension. Freeze selections before evaluating test outcomes.
risk_integration: daqem.risk.gri_risk with deterministic seeds; ordinary multivariate_normal CDF uses maxpts=1000000 and abseps=releps=1e-7; stable rare-tail branches avoid subtraction from one. Exact numerical ties use method-name ordering. Numerical plug-in score, not a risk certificate.

exact_blocks.zne_eval: First t shots at each of 3 scales: 3t per candidate.
exact_blocks.accuracy_zne_total_matched: At each scale combine disjoint blocks (t/2,t] and (2t,4t]: 2.5t per scale, total 7.5t per candidate.
exact_blocks.decision_zne_total_matched: First 2t shots at each scale: 6t per candidate; use same coefficients fitted on fit replicas.

budget_accounting.evaluation_matched: All methods use 3t shots per candidate per test decision. Fit and selection overhead are additional and must be reported.
budget_accounting.end_to_end_matched: For each instance and 20 test decisions: each selector pays 10*3t fit + 10*6t selection + 20*3t evaluation = 150t shots per candidate. Always-Raw and fixed Accuracy-ZNE each use 20*7.5t=150t. Fixed Decision-ZNE pays 10*3t fit + 20*6t evaluation=150t.
budget_accounting.selection_acquisition: Union of all candidate-method records costs 4t on scale 1 and t on each other scale = 6t, not 9t; shared records counted once.
budget_accounting.amortization: Pilot costs amortized over 20 independent decisions on the same fixed landscape. No single-decision or cross-landscape transfer advantage is claimed.
budget_accounting.excluded_costs: Classical ideal simulation, transpilation, computation and storage are not shot costs. Oracle cost is not claimed physically implementable. Quantum noise-learning or hardware calibration not used by this audit.

inference: Report paired failure differences with 95% percentile bootstrap intervals resampling all 48 instance clusters, 10000 draws. Descriptive post hoc intervals; no confirmatory p-values or threshold-pass claims. No optional stopping or selection of favorable budgets.
primary_comparisons: GRI-selector versus always-Raw at equal end-to-end cost
GRI-selector versus MSE-selector at equal end-to-end cost
secondary: Evaluation-matched contrasts and individual method baselines; larger budget is sensitivity, not an independently powered confirmation.
historical_record: v18 source, 52-file freeze, original results and v1.1.0 archive are preserved. This additive package has its own source/input hashes.
integration_revision: current cumulative numerical core; split, budgets and comparison design unchanged
